visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a 2D hand-drawn animation style on a stark white background. A white dog-like character with black eyebrows, representing the narrator, is seated in a teal-colored high-speed rail chair. He has a neutral, somewhat bored expression. Traditional Chinese text appears below the character stating the story's beginning. (2) A second character, an "uncle" figure with short black spiky hair and a blue shirt, appears sitting in an adjacent seat. He holds a blue smartphone and laughs hysterically with his mouth wide open, showing a red tongue. The white dog character shifts his eyes toward the man with a look of extreme annoyance. (3) The uncle character is now depicted holding the phone horizontally, watching a video on YouTube. Yellow graphic lines radiate from the phone to signify loud noise. The white dog character's expression hardens into a glare. The background remains minimal and white, focusing entirely on the characters' interactions. (4) The scene cuts to a wider shot of four different animal characters—a white dog, a yellow bear, a blue dog, and a purple cat—sitting in a row of train seats. All four characters have small blue sweat drops on their heads and look distressed or angry, staring forward in shared silent suffering. (5) The spiky-haired man is shown slumped back in his chair, eyes closed as he sleeps soundly. A single line of drool hangs from the side of his open mouth. His blue smartphone lies flat on the tray table in front of him. The white dog character watches him silently from the left. (6) A rectangular box with a red border and the text "Taichung Station" in bold red characters appears centrally. Below it, the man continues to sleep while his phone on the table vibrates and flashes with yellow light, indicating an active alarm. He remains completely unresponsive to the visual and implied auditory alert. (7) A sequence of passengers, including the yellow bear, purple cat, and blue dog, walk past the sleeping man in a hallway. They each glance at him with expressions ranging from indifference to mild contempt, but none stop to wake him. The man remains in a deep sleep, drooling. (8) The white dog character reappears, pointing two fingers toward the viewer and laughing with a mischievous, joyful expression. His mouth is open in a wide "D" shape, and his eyes are closed in delight. The background is white with subtle gray shading to provide depth. (9) The man wakes up with a jolt, his eyes bulging and bloodshot in shock. Behind him, a sign for "Kaohsiung" station is visible on the wall. He is shown running frantically with tears streaming down his face, holding his phone while the white dog character watches calmly in the background. (10) The footage transitions to a real-life studio setting with warm indoor lighting. A young man with dark hair, wearing a purple hoodie, is seated at a wooden desk. He is focused on signing a stack of white cards with a black marker. Bookshelves filled with figurines and collectibles are visible behind him. (11) Multiple close-up shots show the creator holding up a signed white card featuring a hand-drawn illustration of the white dog character. The desk is covered with several stacks of red envelopes and white cards. The camera is handheld, moving slightly to show the variety of products. (12) A final promotional graphic appears on a yellow sunburst background. It features the white dog character pointing upward next to a set of red envelopes and Chinese New Year couplets. Large red and black text provides product details and a call to action to visit the official website.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice narrating in a clear, professional studio quality. His tone is friendly and conversational, with moderate pitch and steady speech rate. In the background, a playful, upbeat synthesizer melody plays at approximately 120 BPM, creating a lighthearted storytelling atmosphere. (2) A second male voice, characterized as the "uncle," enters with high intensity and volume. He speaks in a loud, abrasive manner, exhibiting high vocal arousal and frequent pitch variations. His speech is marked by the distinct acoustic signature of a smartphone speaker, sounding slightly tinny and compressed. (3) The background music continues, but it is overlaid with the sound of a YouTube video playing through a speaker. This additional audio layer contains fast-paced speech and muffled music, creating a dense and somewhat chaotic acoustic environment. The main narrator's voice remains clear but conveys a sense of frustration. (4) A subtle shift in the BGM occurs, introducing a more rhythmic and repetitive electronic beat. The narrator's speech rate slows down slightly as he describes the shared silence and endurance of the other passengers. There is a lack of ambient noise, indicating a post-produced or studio-recorded narrative track. (5) The loud voices and YouTube audio suddenly stop, replaced by a momentary strategic silence. A faint, low-frequency snoring sound is introduced, characterized by a rhythmic, breathy texture. The BGM drops to a low-volume background bed, allowing the soft snoring to be clearly perceived as the focus. (6) A sharp, high-pitched digital alarm sound—resembling a standard smartphone ringtone—pierces the mix. It has a high spectral brightness and repeats in a consistent, urgent pattern. The narrator continues his commentary, his voice dropping in volume as if whispering to the audience about the situation. (7) Acoustic textures of muffled footsteps on carpet and distant, reverbed public address announcements simulate a train station environment. The alarm continues to beep persistently. The narrator's voice is calm and rhythmic, contrasting with the high-frequency beeping of the phone alarm in the background. (8) The narrator's vocal arousal increases significantly, becoming high-pitched and energetic. He uses an animated, comedic tone to express the "gentle revenge." The BGM swells in volume and brightness, incorporating more percussion and synthesizer layers to match the triumphant mood of the narration. (9) A loud, distorted crying sound from the uncle character dominates the mix. It is characterized by high vocal strain, wide pitch contours, and frequent gasping for air. This is followed by a comedic "stinger" sound effect—a short, descending musical phrase—marking the end of the animated story segment. (10) The audio quality transitions to a field recording style in a studio. A natural conversation between the creator and an off-camera female speaker is heard. Their voices have a casual, everyday tone with normal conversational loudness. A new, catchy pop-style BGM starts playing at a moderate volume. (11) Sound effects of a marker squeaking on paper and the rustling of cardstock are clearly audible, providing organic Foley-style detail. The creator's voice is warm and engaging as he explains the signing process. The articulation is clear, suggesting a high-quality microphone capture in a quiet indoor space. (12) The final segment features the narrator's voice returning to a high-arousal, promotional tone. He speaks rapidly with clear enunciation, encouraging viewers to take action. The BGM increases in intensity and tempo, ending with a bright, resonant chord as the promotional graphic is displayed.
